title: A dead world's dream
description:
A dead world's dream is a challenging retro platformer. 

From your sky island's home, travel to diversified areas and progress in a non-linear way.
Energy cells will allow to boost the portal to reach further away places, while rare species brought back to your biologist friend will allow to unlock capabilities.

Face the challenges with the proven die and retry method, or carefuly analyse your surroundings.

If this is just a walk in the park and fairness is not your style, try the hard mode and regret trying.

 Good luck!
description_short: A Dead World's Dream is a challenging retro platformerAs a peaceful alien, explore a harsh world looking for hidden species.Unlocking upgrades and power-ups, travel to even more treacherous places.Carefuly examine your surroundings before jumping toward new dangers and secrets.
